conditions: The only real bottleneck for a newer player who hasn't reached Europa, Neptune or the Void yet.

rows.label: Carrier

conditions: Claiming needs two free Companion slots: one for Carrier, one for its attached Sweeper shotgun.
bonuses: Sweeper takes Ammo Stock mods; 50% Ammo Stock fires 3-round bursts instead of 2.
Looter's 22m pulse breaks crates and resource deposits as a passive bonus on other farming runs.

disclosures.title: why bother
disclosures.body: Vacuum went universal in 2016-2018 and took away Carrier's must-have status; today its niche is Ammo Case for ammo-starved weapons like Kuva Bramma.
